content.name: Bugs Bunny
content.description: Bugs Bunny, a classic character from the Looney Tunes animated series, shown here with an unimpressed expression and the word 'NO' in bold letters.

scene_context: This image is a popular reaction meme featuring Bugs Bunny from Looney Tunes, used to emphatically reject or dismiss something with a simple 'NO.'

meme.meaning: Used as a reaction image to bluntly and humorously reject a suggestion, request, or statement.
meme.how_a_caption_should_use_it: Caption should set up a scenario or request that is being rejected; the image delivers the emphatic 'NO.'
